Fires on capitalized pronouns/words beginning a sentence or quotation ("We", "You", "I", "Our", and the CamelCase "World" in "OurWorldInData"), and is strongly suppressed by the same first-person pronouns in lowercase mid-sentence position (" us", " we", " our") — i.e., it tracks sentence/quote-initial capitalization of pronoun tokens rather than their meaning.
